QLoRA fine-tune of `Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct` for slot extraction (question -> strict JSON).

* Data: 5700 synthetic training questions and 120 held-out questions, generated by
  `finetune/make_parse_dataset.py` (labels known by construction; typos, lower case, Hinglish fillers,
  missing places and out-of-scope requests are over-sampled).
* LoRA r=16, alpha=32, dropout 0.05 on all attention and MLP projections; 4-bit NF4 base;
  1.0 epoch(s), learning rate 0.0002, effective batch 16, loss on the JSON answer only.
* Hardware: NVIDIA RTX 4500 Ada Generation; wall time 28 min.

Scores below come from this script (transformers, 4-bit, greedy decoding); see the end of this file for the
live API's path (llama.cpp, JSON-schema decoding).

| Metric | Synthetic held-out (120): base | fine-tuned | Real questions (30): base | fine-tuned | Unseen test (40): base | fine-tuned |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| exact | 50.8% | 95.8% | 73.3% | 100.0% | 75.0% | 97.5% |
| activity | 66.7% | 95.8% | 93.3% | 100.0% | 87.5% | 100.0% |
| location | 76.7% | 100.0% | 86.7% | 100.0% | 95.0% | 97.5% |
| profiles | 85.0% | 100.0% | 86.7% | 100.0% | 90.0% | 100.0% |
| valid json | 100.0% | 100.0% | 100.0% | 100.0% | 100.0% | 100.0% |

The synthetic held-out set comes from the same templates as the training data, so it is optimistic.
`finetune/real_eval.jsonl` (30) and `finetune/test_unseen.jsonl` (40) are hand-written and never used for
training; the unseen set was written before this version was trained, with places and phrasings the generator
does not use.

## On the live API's path (llama.cpp, Q4_K_M GGUF, JSON-schema-constrained decoding)

Measured with `finetune/eval_parse.py`. Version 1 was trained on 2,700 examples from the first generator; the error
analysis of version 1 on the 30 real questions showed two patterns (off-topic requests that name a place, and
places after unusual connectors such as "trek to sinhagad"), which version 2's generator covers in general form.
Because the 30 questions guided that analysis, the unseen set is the fairer measure.

| Metric | Base Qwen2.5-1.5B | Version 1 | Version 2 (deployed) |
|---|---|---|---|
| real questions (30), exact | 76.7% | 93.3% | 100.0% |
| unseen test (40), exact | 72.5% | 77.5% | 97.5% |
| unseen test (40), activity | 85.0% | 85.0% | 100.0% |
| unseen test (40), location | 90.0% | 80.0% | 97.5% |
| unseen test (40), profiles | 92.5% | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| off-topic requests caught (6 in the unseen set) | 1 | 1 | 6 |
| answers written by the SLM and passing the grounding check (8 live questions) | 7/8 | 8/8 | 7/8 |

The only miss of version 2 on the 70 hand-written questions: "Worli sea face" was read as "Worli sea".
Answer writing was not a training target; the 7/8 versus 8/8 difference is within run-to-run variation, and a draft
that fails the check is replaced by the verified template.
